verdict.rationale: Role-based view/edit permissions are a fair question for a work-management tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no board, workspace, or member roles and no view/edit permission controls. The only permission-related items concern API token scopes for developer authorization (trello-docs-19/43) and community reports of organization-managed accounts; both are adjacent and do not show a product manager assigning granular roles over who can view or edit work.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
